title: Plan Granny's Birthday Party
goal: Organize a birthday party for granny with a garden theme.

subtasks.text: Set the date and time for the party on May 10th.
Create a guest list of 15 people.
Plan decorations and setup for a garden theme.
Organize food and drinks within a budget of $500.
Arrange for activities suitable for the party.
Coordinate the location and setup at home.

missing_info: What time will the party start?
What specific food and drinks do you want?
What activities or games would you like to include?
